# Schemas
Students (<u>name</u>, major, classYear, dorm)

Clubs (<u>name</u>, category, meetingLocationName, presidentName)

Locations (<u>name</u>, building, capacity)

Events (<u>title, eventDate, startTime</u>, clubName, locationName, organizerName, cost)

Attendance (<u>eventTitle, eventDate, startTime, studentName</u>)

# 1
Find the names of the clubs and the names of the presidents of these clubs, for clubs that hosted events that "Harry Potter" attended.

$> \pi_{name, presidentName}(\\ > \quad \rho_E (\\ > \quad \quad \sigma_{studentName="Harry Potter"}(Attendance)\bowtie Events \\>  \quad) \bowtie_{E.clubName=Clubs.name}Clubs\\ > )$

# 2
Find the names of students who attended no events hosted by clubs in the category "Herbology" in 2026.

$> \pi_{name}( \\ >\quad Students - \pi_{A\in schema(Students)}(\\ > \quad \quad \pi_{studentName}(\\ > \quad \quad \quad \sigma_{category="Herbology"}Clubs \\ > \quad \quad \quad \bowtie_{Clubs.name=E.clubName} \\ > \quad \quad \quad \sigma_{2026-01-01\leq E.eventDate \land E.eventDate \leq 2026-12-31}(\rho_E Events) \\ > \quad \quad \quad \bowtie_{E.title = A.eventTitle \land E.eventDate = A.eventDate \land E.startTime = A.startTime} \\ > \quad \quad \quad \rho_A Attendance \\ > \quad \quad) \bowtie_{A.studentName=Students.name}Students \\ > \quad ) \\ >)$

>> Note that $A\in schema(Students)$ is the set of attributes of students. Thus $\pi_{A\in schema(Students)}$ projects the data onto only attributes of students.

# 3
Find the titles of events that have been used as a title for two or more distinct events (i.e., event titles shared by at least two different event instances).

$> \pi_{title} ( \\ > \quad \rho_{E1} Events \\ > \quad \quad \bowtie_{E1.title=E2.title \land (E1.eventDate \neq E2.eventDate \lor E1.startTime \neq E2.startTime)}\\ > \quad \rho_{E2} Events \\ >)$

>> Join only if their title's are the same and either their times are different or event dates are different

# 4
Find the number of events held at the location "Gryffindor Common Room" that "Harry Potter" attended (Hint: using the $\gamma$ operator).

$> \gamma_{count}( \\ > \quad \sigma_{locationName="Gryffindor Common Room"} \rho_E (Events) \\ > \quad \quad \bowtie_{E.title = A.eventTitle \land E.eventDate = A.eventDate \land E.startTime = A.startTime}\\ > \quad \sigma_{studentName="Harry Potter"} \rho_A(Attendance)  \\ >)$

# 5
Find the names of clubs whose events "Harry Potter" attended, and output for each such club the club name and the total number of "Harry Potter" attendances for that club (Hint: using the $\gamma$ operator).

$>_{Clubs.name} \gamma_{count} (\\ > \quad \sigma_{studentName="Harry Potter"}\rho_A (Attendance) \\ > \quad \quad \bowtie_{E.title = A.eventTitle \land E.eventDate = A.eventDate \land E.startTime = A.startTime} \\> \quad \rho_E Events \\ >)$

# 6
Find the names of students who attended events only in locations that are in the building "Gryffindor Tower".

$> \pi_{studentName} Attendance - \pi_{studentName}( \\ > \quad \sigma_{building!="Gryffindor Tower"} \rho_L Locations \\ > \quad \quad \bowtie_{L.name = E.locationName} \\ > \quad \rho_E (Events) \\ > \quad \quad \bowtie_{E.title = A.eventTitle \land E.eventDate = A.eventDate \land E.startTime = A.startTime}\\ > \quad \rho_A(Attendance)  \\ >)$

# 7
Find the location names and the club names, for each (location, club) pair, such that "Harry Potter" attended every event that club held at that location.

$> \pi_{E.location,E.clubName,A.studentName}( \\ > \quad \rho_E (Events)\\ > \quad \quad \bowtie_{E.title = A.eventTitle \land E.eventDate = A.eventDate \land E.startTime = A.startTime}\\ > \quad \rho_A(Attendance)\\ > ) \quad / \\ >  \pi_{studentName}\sigma_{studentName="Harry Potter"} Attendance$

# 8
Find the club names of clubs that have at least one event whose cost is greater than all event costs of the club named "Slug Club".

$> \rho_{SlugClub}(\gamma_{max(cost)}  \sigma_{clubName="Slug Club"}Events)\\ > \pi_{clubName} (\\ >\quad \sigma_{Events.cost > SlugClub.cost} Events \\ >)$

# 9
Find the names of students who have attended at least one event from every club in the category "Herbology".


$> \pi_{A.studentName, E.clubName}\\> \quad \rho_E Events \\ > \quad \quad \bowtie_{E.title = A.eventTitle \land E.eventDate = A.eventDate \land E.startTime = A.startTime} \\ > \quad \rho_A Attendance \\ > ) \quad /\quad \rho_{HerbologyClubs(clubName)}(\pi_{name}(\sigma_{category="Herbology"} Clubs))$

# 10
Find the names and dorms of students who attended events at every location in the building "Gryffindor Tower", but have never attended any event organized by a student who shares their dorm.

$\\ > \rho_{GryffEventStudents(name)} ( \\ > \quad \pi_{A.studentName, E.locationName}(\\> \quad \quad \rho_E Events \\ > \quad \quad \quad \bowtie_{E.title = A.eventTitle \land E.eventDate = A.eventDate \land E.startTime = A.startTime} \\ > \quad \quad \rho_A Attendance \\ > \quad ) \quad /\quad \rho_{GryffLocs(locationName)}(\pi_{name}(\sigma_{building="Gryffindor Tower"} Locations)) \\ >) \\ > GryffEventStudents  \quad - \quad (\\ > \quad GryffEventStudents \\ > \quad \quad \bowtie \\ > \quad \rho_S Students \\ > \quad \quad \bowtie_{GryffEventStudents.name = A.name} \\ > \quad \rho_A  \\ > \quad \quad\bowtie_{E.title = A.eventTitle \land E.eventDate = A.eventDate \land E.startTime = A.startTime\land S.dorm=O.dorm} \\ > \quad (\rho_E Events \quad \bowtie_{E.organizerName = O.name}\quad  \rho_O Students ) \\ >)$

>> In other words, find students that attended events at all Gryffindor Tower Locations. Then of those students find who have attended events organized by students from the same dorm and remove those students from the list.
